Serving Omaha Metro

When a tenant moves out and leaves a unit full of junk, every day that apartment sits empty is money lost. A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service specializes in rapid-response apartment cleanout services for property managers, landlords, and real estate agents in Omaha. We understand the pressure of tight turnover schedules and provide the reliable, thorough service you need to get your units back on the market fast.

Our crew handles everything from single-unit clearouts to entire building projects. We don't just take the big furniture; we clear out the closets, the cabinets, and the balconies. Whether it's a standard move-out mess or a more challenging eviction situation, we have the experience and the equipment to handle it efficiently and professionally.

Why Property Managers Choose Us

Fast Turnaround Times

We offer same-day and next-day service to ensure your units are cleared and ready for cleaning and repairs as quickly as possible.

Built for Property Managers

Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly can you clear an apartment?

We often provide same-day or next-day service. Most standard apartment cleanouts are completed in just a few hours, allowing your cleaning and maintenance crews to get to work immediately.

Do you handle eviction cleanouts?

Yes. We have extensive experience with eviction situations and can work with you to clear the unit quickly and respectfully while following all local regulations.

What do you do with the junk?

We sort everything we remove. Items in good condition are donated to local Omaha charities, and materials like metal, paper, and plastic are recycled. We only dispose of items that truly cannot be reused or recycled.

Do you offer volume discounts for property managers?

Yes. We work with many property management companies in Omaha and offer competitive commercial rates and volume discounts for ongoing partnerships.
